Erin ML: Quick update from the GPTQ mini-sweep across Llama-2-13b / Mistral-7B-Instruct / Qwen-14B. Ran default GPTQ 4-bit configs + a couple AWQ patches. TL;DR: Mistral holds up best for instruction tasks, Qwen shows KV degradation >8k, Llama has small consistency drift on few-shot prompts.
Samir: cool — can you paste the exact cmds/configs you used?
Erin ML: sure, gist of the run: 
```bash
python run_quant_eval.py --model $MODEL --quant gptq --bits 4 --group-size 128 --seed 42 --eval-sets squad,trivia,hhq --max-context 8192
```
Lucy: results snapshot? numbers?
Erin ML: summary numbers (delta vs fp16 baseline):
- Llama-2-13b GPTQ-4: +35% throughput, mem -46%, EM down 1.8 pts on SQuAD-like set, rouge/cls minor regressions ~1.2
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4: +48% throughput, mem -52%, EM down 0.9 pts, hallucination rate unchanged
- Qwen-14B GPTQ-4: +30% throughput, mem -40%, EM down 2.4 pts, KV-hit drop after ~8k context causing answer truncation
Samir: interesting that Mistral is best for instruction. AWQ/INT8 compared?
Erin ML: ran small AWQ patch on Mistral and Qwen: AWQ-Mistral matched GPTQ latency with slightly better EM (0.3 pts) and fewer logits spikes. AWQ-Qwen improved long-context stability but still ~1.1 pt worse than fp16. INT8 (per-channel) kept quality closer but cost/latency tradeoffs were worse than 4-bit GPTQ for our infra.
Lucy: any weird failure modes?
Erin ML: Qwen GPTQ produced occasional repeated-token loops on multi-step chains — looks like KV misalign on some attention matmul kernels. Also saw slight preference flips on instruction-following prompts for Llama under 4-bit (rare but deterministic on a seed).
Matt Ops: what about deployment profiles? can we ship a canary config?
Erin ML: proposed profile:
- Canary: Mistral-AWQ (small traffic, 5 qps), fallback to Mistral-fp16 on regressions
- Stage: Llama-GPTQ-4 for latency-sensitive workloads with a per-route quality alert (prompt set evals every 10k requests)
- Avoid Qwen-GPTQ for >8k contexts; prefer Qwen-AWQ or fp16 for long-context routes
Samir: do we have eval artifacts?
eval-bot: New eval uploaded: https://storage.redwood/reports/2920001111-summary.html (includes per-prompt diffs, logits hist, kv-hit traces)
Lucy: nice. action items?
Erin ML: 1) run wider AWQ sweep on Mistral (samir + lucy) 2) triage Qwen KV loop (Matt Ops + infra) 3) add small canary and prompt-set checks to console rollout (me)
Samir: I'll kick off AWQ runs today.
Matt Ops: I'll provision a small canary pool and add kernel tracing for the Qwen run.
Erin ML: thanks — will post updated numbers and a compact heatmap in this thread. :thumbsup:
